-Physical AI / Robotics Engineer
Company: Variety Innovation Venture Pvt Ltd
Location: Gurgaon / Delhi NCR
Experience: 2+ Years
Employment Type: Full-Time
Salary Package: - 4LPA -6 LPA, (based on experience & technical knowledge)

About Variety Innovation Venture Pvt Ltd
Variety Innovation Venture Pvt. Ltd. (VIV) is a technology-driven Research & Development company specializing in Robotics, Industrial Automation, Machine Vision, Industry 4.0, IIoT, and Industrial Software Development. VIV operates with a strong focus on innovation, technical excellence, engineering capabilities, and practical automation solutions, helping businesses improve productivity, quality, efficiency, and process automation.

Our Brands
Unbox Industry -A technology-focused brand offering industrial automation, robotics, and related products and solutions, supporting businesses in adopting modern automation technologies.
Nferent AI -An AI-focused technology brand working on Artificial Intelligence and intelligent technology solutions, with a focus on applying AI to emerging real-world use cases.
Together, Variety Innovation Venture, Unbox Industry, and Nferent AI represent a technology ecosystem focused on Robotics, Automation, AI, and next-generation industrial solutions, providing an innovative and collaborative environment for professionals who want to work on emerging technologies.

About the Job Role

We are looking for a hands-on technical leader to manage after-sales support for robotics hardware at Unbox Industry and lead the team at Nferent AI working on robotics data collection and AI model deployment.

The role involves installing, testing, troubleshooting, and supporting new robotics products, as well as training and guiding the team on their use. The candidate will work closely with robotics hardware, emerging AI technologies, and international clients, ensuring smooth product operation and project execution.

What you'll own

Data collection & model deployment -Nferent AI (80% Work Effort)



Lead a team of research engineers on daily capture: set protocol, assign work, review output, unblock people on the floor
Own the full capture stack -ego cameras, 3D/stereo cameras, UMI-class handheld grippers, teleop systems, leader-follower arms, cobots, humanoids, data gloves ncluding calibration, multi-camera sync, and pose validation
Keep learning new hardware on an ongoing basis: bring up unfamiliar devices, write internal SOPs, and train the team on each
Define and enforce data QC - coverage, task diversity, file structure- so datasets pass customer acceptance the first time
Help fine-tune and deploy VLA models (e.g. 0.5) on real robots; set up cloud training + local inference, run structured evaluations, and use failures to inform what gets captured next.


After-sales support -Unbox Industry (20% Work Effort)



Own post-sale installation, commissioning, and troubleshooting for all robotic and non-robotic products we sell a on-site or remote
Serve as the technical escalation point for sales, including on pre-sales calls where a technical answer decides the deal

Diagnose field failures and drive warranty/RMA cases with OEMs through to closure, including the paperwork our distribution/import role requires
Run customer training and handovers; build commissioning checklists and troubleshooting SOPs so support doesn't depend on one person's memory
Track recurring failure modes across brands and feed them back into what we stock and

recommend

What we're looking for
Required


3+ years in robotics, automation, or mechatronics with real hands-on hardware time -not just simulation
Strong Python, comfortable in Linux; can script and debug without hand-holding
Working knowledge of ROS/ROS 2, kinematics, and coordinate transforms
Hands-on experience with industrial or collaborative robot arms- setup, integration, fault diagnosis
Demonstrated ability to lead or mentor a small technical team
Comfortable talking to a plant manager and an OEM engineer in the same afternoon
Willing to travel to customer sites and work on-site in Gurugram


Preferred


Experience with teleoperation, UMI-style capture, MoCap, or egocentric data collection
PyTorch/CUDA; exposure to VLA or imitation-learning models ( 0-family, OpenVLA, ACT, diffusion policy)
Background in industrial after-sales or field service engineering
Experience with humanoid platforms, dexterous hands, or tactile sensors
Experience with reinforcement learning, imitation learning or robot learning.
Experience with Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, MuJoCo or Gazebo.
Experience with robotic arms, AMRs, humanoids or mobile manipulators.
Experience deploying AI models on NVIDIA Jetson or edge GPUs.
Experience working with real-world robotics datasets and data pipelines.

Education
Bachelor's/Master's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, AI/ML, Electronics, Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
Ideal Candidate
Someone who is excited about the intersection of AI + Robotics + the Physical World, and enjoys moving beyond research/prototypes to building AI systems that actually operate on real robots.

Key Responsibilities:



AI & LLM Application Development:
Design, build, and deploy custom applications using Claude (Anthropic API) and OpenAI APIs (GPT-4/GPT-4o), tailored for legal workflows.
Implement advanced prompt engineering, structured JSON outputs, system instructions, and tool/function calling.
Develop conversational assistants, legal document summarizers, and automated contract review tools.
RAG & Knowledge Retrieval:
Build and optimize RAG pipelines to index and query large repositories of legal documents, statutes, case law, and internal law firm knowledge bases.
Work with vector databases to enable highly accurate semantic search with precise citation tracking.
Domain-Specific Customization & Quality Control:
Tailor AI models to handle legal terminology, formatting standards, and domain-specific edge cases.
Implement rigorous evaluation, benchmarking, and hallucination-mitigation frameworks to ensure high precision, compliance, and reliability required for legal deliverables.
Ensure strict data privacy, confidentiality, and enterprise-grade security standards across all AI pipelines.
Collaboration & Integration:
Collaborate with legal teams, partners, and paralegals to translate complex legal requirements into actionable AI features.
Integrate AI services into existing legal management tools, practice management systems, or custom firm web applications.
Experience developing Autonomous Agents or multi-agent orchestrations for multi-step reasoning tasks.



Required Qualifications & Skills



Experience: Minimum 2+ years of hands-on experience developing applications with Large Language Models (LLMs).
Legal Domain Expertise: Prior experience working within a law firm, corporate legal department, or LegalTech company strongly preferred.
LLM & API Mastery: Deep expertise with Anthropic Claude (handling long context windows, vision capabilities, prompt caching) and OpenAI APIs (Assistants API, function calling, embeddings).
Programming Languages: Proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript / Node.js.
Frameworks & Orchestration: Experience with frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom agentic workflows.
Vector Databases & Search: Hands-on experience with vector search engines and hybrid search architectures.
Backend & Cloud Development: Experience with REST APIs, FastAPI, microservices, and modern cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
Education: Bachelors degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, or equivalent practical experience.



Nice-to-Have Skills



Familiarity with existing LegalTech solutions (e.g., Harvey, Legora etc.) and document management systems.
Knowledge of fine-tuning techniques (LoRA, QLoRA) for domain-adapted models.
Basic understanding of legal privileges, client data handling, and compliance requirements (e.g., SOC 2, ISO).

Roles and Responsibility
Design and develop AI models and algorithms to solve complex problems.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI solutions into existing systems.
Develop and maintain large-scale data pipelines and architectures.
Conduct research and stay updated on the latest advancements in AI and machine learning.
Work closely with stakeholders to understand business needs and provide technical guidance.
Develop and implement automated testing frameworks to ensure high-quality deliverables.
Job Requirements
Strong proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, or C++.
Experience with deep learning frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch.
Excellent understanding of computer vision, natural language processing, and reinforcement learning concepts.
Strong mathematical foundations in linear algebra, calculus, and probability theory.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and collaborate effectively with teams.
Strong communication and problem-solving skills.

Its fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!

Were committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Role Overview:

We are looking for a hands-on Lead Engineer / Architect with strong payments, transaction processing, and AI/agent engineering experience to design and build AI-driven solutions capable of executing end-to-end transactions across multiple markets.

The role will own the technical solution from requirements and architecture through agent development, payment integration, testing, and successful transaction execution.

Key Responsibilities:

Design and build AI agents capable of initiating, processing, and completing end-to-end payment transactions.
Understand the payment transaction lifecycle and translate payment requirements into agent workflows, business rules, APIs, and system integrations.
Analyze market-specific payment requirements and variations and design configurable, reusable solutions.
Define architecture for agent orchestration, transaction state management, tool/API invocation, exception handling, retries, and recovery.
Integrate agents with payment platforms, gateways, transaction processing systems, APIs, and enterprise services.
Define appropriate boundaries between AI-driven decisioning and deterministic payment/business logic.
Develop primarily using Python, LLMs, and appropriate agent frameworks.
Implement security, authorization, auditability, observability, and guardrails around agent-driven payment actions.
Lead end-to-end testing and demonstrate successful transaction execution for each target market.
Provide hands-on technical leadership, conduct design/code reviews, and mentor engineers.

Required Experience:

10+ years of software engineering experience, including architecture and technical leadership.
Strong hands-on Python development experience.
Proven experience designing and building LLM/GenAI applications and AI agents.
Strong understanding of payments and transaction processing.
Experience with payment APIs, gateways, transaction processing platforms, or payment services.
Strong understanding of payment lifecycle concepts such as transaction initiation, authorization, processing, transaction status, exceptions, and completion.
Strong experience with REST APIs, microservices, distributed systems, and cloud platforms.
Experience designing enterprise integrations and event-driven architectures.
Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP.

AI / Agent Experience:

Experience building AI agents and agent-based workflows.
Experience with agent orchestration, tool/function calling, structured outputs, and LLM integration.
Experience with frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, or equivalent.
Experience implementing AI guardrails, evaluation, observability, and human-in-the-loop controls.
Ability to determine where AI should be used versus deterministic rules within payment workflows.

Preferred Experience:

Experience across multiple payment markets or regional payment ecosystems.
Knowledge of payment authorization, clearing, settlement, reconciliation, fraud/risk, disputes, or exception management.
Experience with Kafka or other event-streaming technologies.
Experience designing configurable architectures supporting market-specific payment variations.

Success Criteria:

The successful candidate will be able to take a payment transaction requirement, design the agent and supporting architecture, build the solution, integrate with the required payment systems, and demonstrate a successfully completed transaction for each designated market.

This is a hands-on architecture and engineering role. The candidate must be comfortable coding, debugging, integrating payment systems, and owning the end-to-end technical solution.

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, youll enjoy your career with us!

Not the right fit Let us know youre interested in a future opportunity by clicking Introduce Yourself in the top-right corner of the page or create an account to set up email alerts as new job postings become available that meet your interest!

Job Summary

We are seeking an innovative and hands-on Agentic AI Engineer to design, build, and deploy autonomous AI agents that solve real business problems. You will develop intelligent AI systems capable of planning, reasoning, collaborating with other agents, integrating with enterprise applications, and executing complex workflows with minimal human intervention.

The ideal candidate has strong software engineering skills, experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), and a passion for building next-generation AI applications.

Responsibilities
Build and maintain agentic workflows using frameworks like LangGraph(preferable),LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, N8N
Implement tool/function calling integrations connecting agents to internal APIs, databases, and third-party services (including MCP-based connectors)
Develop multi-step reasoning loops (ReAct, planner-executor, reflection patterns) and debug failure cases when agents go off-script
Own prompt engineering and iteration for agent instructions, system prompts, and few-shot examples
Implement short-term and long-term memory (vector stores, session state) so agents retain useful context
Add guardrails: input/output validation, action confirmation steps, retry/rollback logic rate limiting on autonomous actions
Set up observability - logging, tracing (LangSmith/Langfuse), and dashboards to monitor agent behavior in production
Write evaluation harnesses (test cases, golden datasets, LLM-as-judge scoring) to catch regressions before deploy
Work closely with senior engineers/leads on architecture decisions, and with product on translating workflows into agent capabilities
Participate in code review, on-call rotation, and incident response for agent-related issues
Stay current with emerging AI frameworks, models, and industry best practices.
Qualifications
5-7 years of professional software engineering experience, with 4+ years specifically working with LLMs/GenAI in production
Strong Python (or TypeScript) skills; comfortable owning a service end-to-end
Practical, hands-on experience with at least one agent orchestration framework (LangGraph, CrewAI, N8N, LlamaIndex, etc.) - not just tutorials, real shipped work
Solid grasp of prompt engineering, function/tool calling, and structured output (JSON schema, Pydantic validation)
Experience with RAG pipelines and vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, pgvector)
Understanding of LLM API usage patterns - streaming, retries, rate limits, cost/token management
Familiarity with evaluating non-deterministic systems (eval sets, LLM-as-judge, A/B testing)
Experience with REST/GraphQL APIs, Git, CI/CD, and basic cloud deployment (GCP)
Ability to debug multi-step, non-deterministic pipelines without losing patience

Job Summary
As a Lead AI Engineer, you will own the design, delivery, and evolution of AI enabled legal solutions that support contract and compliance driven workflows across the enterprise. This role focuses on building and orchestrating agent based AI systems that integrate with Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) platforms and enterprise workflow tools to ensure AI is embedded into governed, auditable legal processes.
You will lead endtoend solution design from intake through execution and post signature intelligence while making informed buy vs. build decisions, providing delivery estimation, and implementing scalable, secure AI solution architecture. This role requires close partnership with Legal, Procurement, Compliance, and IT, to deliver AI solutions that accelerate legal operations while maintaining regulatory and risk controls.
Key Responsibilities
Lead design and implementation of endtoend Legal AI workflows, including intake, orchestration, execution, and post signature intelligence
Evaluate and execute buy vs. build decisions for Legal AI capabilities, including delivery estimation, integration complexity, and total cost of ownership
Design and build custom AI agents to support legal use cases such as contract analysis, clause extraction, summarization, risk identification, and compliance validation
Implement orchestrated, multiagent systems that integrate AI services with CLM platforms and enterprise workflows
Architect and maintain secure, scalable integrations between AI systems and legal platforms, ensuring CLM remains the authoritative system of record
Establish engineering best practices for prompt design, agent orchestration, evaluation, monitoring, and AI governance in legal contexts
Collaborate closely with Legal, Procurement, Compliance, and IT stakeholders to translate legal requirements into durable AI solutions
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineers contributing to Legal AI initiatives
Required Qualifications
Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field
610+ years of experience designing and delivering software or AI enabled systems in production environments
Strong experience building LLM powered applications, agentic workflows, and AI driven services
Proven ability to design endtoend enterprise workflows, including integrations with multiple business systems
Strong programming experience in Python and API based integration development
Experience leveraging AI assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code or similar) to accelerate agent development, integration, and iterative refinement
Demonstrated experience making architecture and delivery tradeoff decisions in complex enterprise environments
Strong communication skills with the ability to engage technical and nontechnical stakeholders
Preferred Qualifications
Experience working with Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) or legal workflow platforms
Familiarity with legal or enterprise platforms such as Agiloft, Eudia, ServiceNow App Engine, GEP CLM, or similar systems
Domain knowledge in any of the following areas:
Procurement contracting
Commercial and vendor contract lifecycle management
Marketing compliance
Legal or regulatory affairs
Experience implementing AI solutions that clearly separate intelligence layers, workflow orchestration, and systems of record

We are hiring AI Engineers to experiment, architect and build AI solutions, mentor engineers, and shape AI strategy that drives learning outcomes and equity for all
In this role, you will design, fine-tune and deploy advanced LLMs (GPT, BERT, open-source models) and Mixture-of-Experts applications for diverse real-world learning applications
You will establish AI-driven decision intelligence frameworks with automated evaluation and A/B testing for prompts and model outputs, create prompt and chain flows using best practices, mentor junior engineers, and expose models and pipelines via clean, secure APIs (FastAPI/Flask)
You will write high-quality, well-tested production code and maintain thorough documentation

We are hiring at all levels, from engineers with 2+ years of experience to senior leadership / CTO

Location - Remote- Bengaluru,Hyderabad,Delhi / NCR,Chennai,Pune,Kolkata,Ahmedabad,Mumbai

AI Model Development & Deployment:
Design and develop ML and GenAI models for airport retail use cases such as demand forecasting, personalized recommendations, anomaly detection in passenger flows, and real-time store optimization.
Conduct exploratory data analysis (EDA), build data pipelines, and perform data engineering to prepare high-quality datasets from diverse sources.
Deploy, monitor, and optimize AI models in production environments, ensuring scalability, low latency, and reliability.
Implement MLOps best practices for model lifecycle management and continuous improvement.
Collaboration & Roadmap Alignment:
Collaborate with product managers, architects, and cross-functional teams to align AI initiatives with business goals.
Integrate AI solutions seamlessly into product roadmaps and enterprise systems.
